bias.en: Neutral turning bearish · MACD and SAR flipped
bias.zh: 中性转弱 · MACD 与 SAR 翻空

read.en: Alphabet fell 2.5% on Oct 16 to $340.59 after a low of $339.08. It closed just under the rising 200-day average ($340.9) and below the 30-day ($344.7), 5-day ($348.8), 10-day ($348.9) and falling 100-day ($350.9). MACD crossed below its signal on Oct 16 while still above zero, Parabolic SAR flipped bearish the same day ($359.4, the Oct 14 high), and RSI is 44.
read.zh: Alphabet 10月16日下跌 2.5%，盘中低见 $339.08，收于 $340.59。股价收在上行的 200 日均线（$340.9）下方一线，并位于 30 日（$344.7）、5 日（$348.8）、10 日（$348.9）和下行的 100 日均线（$350.9）下方。MACD 于 10月16日下穿信号线，仍在零轴之上，抛物线 SAR 同日转为看空（$359.4，10月14日高点），RSI 为 44。

read.en: The $345 support (30-day average) broke on the close, but the day's low held above the Oct 1 low ($335.5). Resistance is $344.7 (30-day), then $349–352 (5, 10 and 100-day averages, Oct 15 high) and $359.4 (SAR). Support is $335.5, then $327.7 (Sep 10 low) and $315 (Jul 23 low). A close below $335.5 would open $327.7; a close back above $345 would target $352.
